basis: Read standard JSDoc from JavaScript syntax and local bindings without executing source or inventing the kind and signature of a foreign export.

cases.claim: A documented foreign re-export retains its public alias, authored annotations and import origin without inventing a callable signature.
cases.test: reads authored re-export documentation without inventing the foreign binding's kind

cases.claim: A local exported alias retains its callable declaration's JSDoc and actual parameter syntax.
cases.test: local exports retain their declaration's documentation and real parameter syntax

cases.claim: Default callable declarations, expressions and local aliases are documented under their public default name.
cases.test: default callable declarations, expressions and local aliases are documented

cases.claim: Non-callable locals, cyclic aliases and unresolved export-star statements do not become invented function records.
cases.test: non-callable locals, cyclic aliases and export-star do not fabricate function records

cases.claim: Invalid text-file carriers and malformed JavaScript refuse before emitting documentation.
cases.test: refuses invalid carriers and invalid JavaScript

cases.claim: An installed caller can read the public name, description, parameter and return type of a documented function.
An installed reader extracts actual callable documentation from the installed upstream parser module.
An installed caller distinguishes local callable aliases and defaults from unresolved foreign bindings without executing supplied source.
